CustomField.description: Sales-user-entered total dollar amount for a Hardware as a Service (001-INFR-ASC-HAAS-HAAS-001) line, already including markup/tax/APR from the HaaS pricing worksheet. JTLPreHook divides this by the line's PricingTermCount to derive UnitPrice, so the platform's own extension reproduces this exact total as NetTotalPrice and the correct monthly figure as MRR__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the total hardware, tax and financing from the HaaS external worksheet.
CustomField.label: HaaS Hardware Amount
